assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service was performed under CPT 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
As the authorization was absent, the claim cannot be processed for payment at this time.
The member retains the right to appeal this determination.

Detailed instructions regarding the appeals process, including necessary documentation and submission deadlines, are available in the member's Summary of Benefits and Coverage or by contacting Member Services directly.
